Race Prediction Rules!{KP}It's a horse-racing-style game with rabbits and turtles!{KP}Up to 4 people can play, 100 ryo each!{KP}The marks beside the rabbits' and turtles' faces show their status!{KP}The top mark is their condition!{KP}The second is the Hermit-sama's prediction of the finishing order!{KP}And the last is how they like today's weather!{KP}The rest is the same as single-player! Predict the order!

Rabbit-Turtle Race Rules!{KP}8 runners in all, rabbits and turtles, will race!{KP}The face marks on the left of the course show the condition of today's runners!{KP}You can also check how the race is going on the right of the course!{KP}Now, enjoy that big Derby feeling!
